# Communication regression records

These are the actual fictional contributions and independently authored claim
and editorial assessments from the local teaching checks on 14 September 2026.
The native workflow generates the FAQ and email anew in each regression run.
These records are test inputs, not prepared lesson outputs, learner decisions,
professional approvals or evidence of fresh model execution in CI. They are
outside every plugin package and every teaching kit.

All four model artifacts and the historical prepared intake retain their exact
original bytes. The intake template changes only source paths to repository
relative paths for portable replay. The manifest binds every fixture and current
packaged source by SHA-256; changing a lesson source requires a fresh assessment.
Historical run paths and timestamps in the retained evidence remain historical.
The replay prepares new local packets without rewriting the original assessments.
The contract's historical intake hash identifies that retained original, and the
test verifies the same objective, audience, jurisdiction, studio brief and colors
against the current runtime intake.

Session identities are host attestations, not authenticated provider receipts.
The exact serving model was unavailable. The seven-case assessor qualification
was performed in a separate session. Professional review transitions in the
tests are explicitly synthetic, and sending and publishing stay unselected.

The current records use revision 02: each draft labels its firm and assignment
as fictional, and the Lucia FAQ no longer repeats the same six answers through
both body and sections. The revised text received fresh independent claim
assurance and a new seven-case-qualified editorial review. All twenty current
claim outcomes are ready for professional review, and all editorial verdicts
are ready. These verdicts do not approve sending or replace review of the actual
packaged output. Earlier versions remain in the local review workspaces.

The final editorial session is `/root/communication_editorial_isolated_07`,
separate from the blind qualification session. Earlier same-session records
were rejected by the native gate and are not used by these fixtures. Current
claim reassessments preserve the distinction between contribution checks and
downstream rendering/version-retention checks. The actual native pipeline now
accepts the schema's empty issue list as well as an explicit `none` entry, while
unresolved defects and professional-judgment routing remain blocking checks.

The claim assessor disclosed that a session-inventory call showed other agents'
completion-status blurbs. It did not open their assessments or generation
transcripts. That disclosure is retained in the original assessment provenance.
